intro: Three songwriters and bandleaders in close harmony.
story: I'm With Her is Sara Watkins, Sarah Jarosz and Aoife O'Donovan, who first sang together at a 2014 Telluride Bluegrass Festival workshop and played as a trio in January 2015 at Celtic Connections. See You Around, produced by Ethan Johns, came out on Rounder in February 2018, and they played Pickathon that summer. "Call My Name" won the 2020 Grammy for Best American Roots Song, and Wild and Clear and Blue won Best Folk Album at the 2026 Grammys.
artist_reel_line: Wild and Clear and Blue won Best Folk Album at the 2026 Grammys.

intro: A Boise indie-rock band led by guitarist Doug Martsch.
story: Built to Spill, from Boise, Idaho, are led by guitarist Doug Martsch and have made records since 1993, among them Perfect from Now On, in 1997. Untethered Moon, their eighth album and first in six years, came in 2015 with a new rhythm section, Jason Albertini and Stephen Gere, both former roadies. They played Pickathon in 2018. When the Wind Forgets Your Name came out on Sub Pop in 2022, and they returned to the farm that year.
artist_reel_line: When the Wind Forgets Your Name came out on Sub Pop in 2022.
